title: Main Street Station, about 1952
method: The station is modeled from curated parts: the train shed from HAER VA-4's measured drawings (1970), traced from the cross section and the plan; the head house's massing fitted to OpenStreetMap, its floors from the written description of HABS VA-848 (1969) and the National Register nomination (1970), its heights scaled from photographs. No plan of the head house is known: its rooms are placed approximately. No other building stands in the frame; the streets and today's OSM features follow the downtown series' era rules (no I-95 before 1958). Trains are illustrative. Every part names its sources.
about: Main Street Station, the Union Station of the Seaboard Air Line and the Chesapeake and Ohio, opened on 27 November 1901 (HABS VA-848). The Seaboard left for Broad Street Station in 1959.

epochs.title: Main Street Station, about 1952
epochs.note: Both railroads still used the station; I-95 was not yet built beside it (opened 1958).

features.note: A train standing at a platform: heavyweight coaches in Pullman green.
